title: Public Alert No. 01/2025 – NAFDAC has Discontinued Registration of Multi-Dose Artemether /Lumefantrine Dry Powder for Oral Suspension

products.brand: All brands of Multi-Dose Artemether/Lumefantrine dry powder oral Suspension

summary: NAFDAC has discontinued registration of all multi-dose Artemether/Lumefantrine dry powder for oral suspension, local or imported, because the reconstituted suspension is unstable and loses efficacy. Importation, distribution, sale and use must stop; stock will be mopped up.
